notes: Security: DiskGarden now verifies updates with a new signing key. Installing this update switches your copy over — it is a required update, because versions before 1.0.7 cannot check the new signature.

Full-disk scans keep their results in memory instead of writing them to a temporary file, and results that need administrator rights are passed straight back to the app rather than through a file on disk.
Remembers when you first started using DiskGarden on this Mac (stored only on your Mac), so early users can be thanked later.
Maintenance release: checks updates from 1.0.4. Nothing else changes.
When an update is required, the update screen installs an update that has already downloaded, and shows progress while one is downloading.
